page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a brace grouping lines beside it; no margin notes; page number at the top right; signature "H" and catchword "Imper." at the foot.

main_text.p: Noi ammamo, nos amamus, wir haben geliebt.
Voi amaste, vos amauistis, jhr habt geliebt.
Coloro amarono, & amaron, illi amauerunt, vel & auff gemeine weise.
main_text.head: Præterito Plusquamperfect.
main_text.p: Io haueua, tu haueui, colui haueua, amato, hatte geliebt.
Noi haueuamo, voi haueuate, Coloro haueano, amato, wir hatten, jhr hattet, sie hatten geliebt.
Ego amaueram, tu amaueras, ille amauerat, er hatte geliebt.
Nos amaueramus, vos amaueratis, illi amauerunt, sie hatten geliebt.
main_text.head: Futurum.
main_text.p: Io amerò, ego amabo, ich werde lieben.
Tu amerai, tu amabis, du wirst lieben.
Colui amerà, ille amabit, er wird lieben.
Noi ameremo, nos amabimus, wir werden lieben.
Voi amarete, vos amabitis, jhr werdet lieben.
Coloro ameranno & amarauno, sie werden lieben.

page.notes: Brace lines on the left group the Italian pronouns with "amato" and "amato" (Latin "amati"); the reading "amato" in the Plusquamperfect is hard to confirm. Some Italian forms (e.g. "Coloro hanno", "amata") are faint. Several words are blurred by show-through and may be misread.
